BiblicalUsage: Lo is Daniel's word for the visions that open before him, and it is used five times in one chapter. Daniel says I saw in my vision by night, and behold, the four winds of the heaven strove upon the great sea; and later, I saw in the night visions, and behold, one like the Son of man came with the clouds of heaven.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for behold carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the wonder in it, that the visions begin with looking, and the looking is given to a man in exile who is told to watch.
